interest: Japanese and Swedish spies in London serving Germany before Pearl Harbor.
overview: Two papers on Japanese activity in Britain: Gunther's 1941 telegram on a spy ring for Germany and Grew's Hong Kong leaflets.

people.name: Genji Miura
people.role: Head of a spy organization working for Germany; formerly connected with Kokusai Kisen Kaisha

people.name: Svenson
people.role: Minor employee of the Swedish Legation or newspaperman assisting German espionage

subfiles.about: Reports intelligence received in Bucharest regarding Japanese and Swedish espionage activities in London on behalf of Germany.
subfiles.summary: Gunther reports that Japanese officials in London gave Germany intelligence, naming Genji Miura as head of a spy ring and a Swede named Svenson.
subfiles.title: Telegram from Gunther (Bucharest) on Japanese and Swedish Espionage in London for Germany

subfiles.about: Cross-reference note for a despatch from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew transmitting Japanese propaganda leaflets dropped over Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's 1942 despatch with Japanese leaflets dropped over Hong Kong.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch from Grew on Japanese Leaflets Dropped Over Hong Kong
